places.name: Census TIGERweb incorporated places and CDPs (city names and limits)

ev.name: AFDC station list (USDOT/BTS NTAD copy, daily)

tree_equity.name: American Forests Tree Equity Score, state block-group files

crash_national.name: NHTSA FARS fatal crashes 2023 (final) and 2024 (initial), USDOT/BTS NTAD copies
crash_national.note: fetch_oc.py fetch_fars; fatal crashes only, so the injury-crash scores (pbcr, ksi) stay absent outside California until a state injury source is added

crash_il.name: Illinois DOT crash records 2016-2025 (all reportable crashes, KABCO injuries, pedestrian / pedalcyclist first harmful event)
crash_il.note: region.STATE_DEFAULTS; 2016-2018 extracts store longitude unsigned (fixed on read)

crash_va.name: Virginia DOT crash records 2017-2025 (all reportable crashes, KABCO injuries, pedestrian / bike flags)
crash_va.note: no 2016 records in the layer: a 9-year window

crash_ut.name: Utah DOT crash records 2019-2025 (UDOT UPlan, all reportable crashes, killed / suspected serious injury counts, pedestrian / bicyclist flags)
crash_ut.note: one layer per year; each misses about one day at its edges (1 Jan before 07:00, 31 Dec after 07:00 as stored)

crash_pa.name: Pennsylvania DOT crash records 2017-2023 (PennShare, all reportable crashes, fatal / suspected serious injury counts, pedestrian and bicycle counts)
crash_pa.note: 2019-2023 has crash month and year only (no day); 2017-2018 from the 2017-2021 table, deduplicated by CRN; 2024 onwards not on an allowed host (gis.penndot.gov)

crash_me.name: MaineDOT crash records 2016-2025 (all reportable crashes, K / A / B / C person counts, pedestrian / bicycle flags)
crash_me.note: a rolling ten-year view, updated weekly: 2016 will drop out of it

crash_tn.name: Tennessee Dept. of Safety TITAN injury and fatal crashes 2021 - 2 Dec 2025 (pedestrian / pedalcyclist flags, crash severity)
crash_tn.note: two dashboard snapshots (July 2023 for 2021-2022, Dec 2025 for 2023-2025); property-damage-only crashes are not included

schools_national.name: NCES EDGE public school locations (current school year)
schools_national.note: fetch_oc.py fetch_schools outside California (NCES's own ArcGIS Online layer)

crime_ca.name: CA DOJ Crimes & Clearances by agency

fire_ca.name: CAL FIRE Fire Hazard Severity Zones (SRA 2023, LRA 2025)

fire_national.name: USFS Wildfire Hazard Potential
fire_national.note: candidate checked 6 Nov 2026: Esri's block-group summary of USFS WHP gives MIN/MAX/MEAN only, not the share of a block group in the highest class that the engine's fire metric uses (CAL FIRE Very High share); the USFS rasters (imagery.geoplatform.gov) are on a host not allowed here. Fire stays absent outside CA

transit.name: GTFS feeds from the MobilityData catalog (mirrored on storage.googleapis.com)
transit.note: fetch_oc.py fetch_gtfs_mdb: active feeds overlapping the county, one per provider, schedules ended over a year ago skipped; bus departures 07:00-09:00 on one weekday per feed. Orange County keeps its OCTA feed

tax_shares_ca.name: County Auditor-Controller tax-rate-area factors + BOE TRA map
tax_shares_ca.note: BOE publishes TRA maps for every CA county; each Auditor's factor report format differs (OC parser written)

assessor.name: County Assessor parcels/sales
assessor.note: LA County: ready (page inventory); others vary
